original_benchmark.name: Claw-Eval
original_benchmark.description: 300 human-verified tasks across 9 categories for trustworthy evaluation of autonomous agents. Evaluates completion, safety, and robustness.

splits.name: general
splits.description: Core agent tasks across communication, finance, ops, productivity, etc.

splits.name: multimodal
splits.description: Perception and creation tasks including webpage generation, video QA, document extraction, etc.

splits.name: multi_turn
splits.description: Conversational tasks with simulated user personas for clarification and advice.

original_benchmark.evaluation_methodology: LLM-as-judge grading against human-verified rubrics, multi-round evaluation for robustness

known_limitations: Full fixture files (videos, large datasets) are not included in the GitHub repo, available separately on Hugging Face
Multi-turn conversation tracking requires agent to implement conversation history logging
Grading quality depends on the judge model used
changelog: 1.0.0: Initial release with full 300 task support
